Standard: At first, I intend to head back home immediately. Then, I remember what's waiting for me there, and I pause.
An image of Adrianne flashes through my mind. I need someone to talk to, someone who won't hurt me.{wc}I turn around, and head towards the village. I break out of the forest, and my pace quickens.
When I finally reach the village, I'm almost running. I come to a halt in the town centre, and look around, when—
Justice has been served. Another fallen soul has been purged from this world! Witness her fate, and repent your sins! Repent!
I don't hear a word he says.
In the centre of the town square is a makeshift gallows.
Hanging in that gallows, swinging slowly in the faint wind, is a lump of flesh; grey, rotten, and lifeless...
I collapse to my knees. What happened? What in god's name could have happened here?
Just three days ago, Adrianne had been so full of life. Why...
Why not Mary? She's the one they were hunting for, right? She's the damned witch! She's the one who... deserves... to...
I can't afford any more attention, and I can't bear to stay here even a second longer, so I run.
Without any thought of where I'm running to, my feet pick up speed until the world around me seems to fade into the distance.
I bite my lip to fight back the tears. I'm already getting some stares from the crowd.
I only stop, and collapse onto the dirt, gasping for breath, when the village is no longer in sight.
